title: Hypnos: a curated, tier-annotated dataset of anesthetic PK/PD models
description: Hypnos is a curated, citation-backed, machine-readable dataset of the population pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic models that anesthetic simulation, TCI research, and depth-of-anesthesia modeling depend on. Every model carries an explicit confidence tier, its derivation population, its applicability envelope, its documented failure modes, and its published predictive-performance metrics, and exports into PharmML, NONMEM, nlmixr2/rxode2, Pumas, SBML, and COMBINE .omex. NOT a dosing tool and NOT a pump driver; research/education/simulation only.
notes: Code is MIT-licensed; the dataset (dataset/) is CC-BY-4.0. When you use a model record, cite Hypnos AND the model's original primary source (model.primary_citation).
